admitted.nl: Create an 8x4 checker-stripe pattern where the sole nonzero input is duplicated at positions (1,1),(1,3),(5,1),(5,3), and fill even rows' even columns with 8.

Rotate a 4x2 input into an 8x4 output via four quadrant copies, with zeros transformed to 8 wherever output row and column are even.
Make a 2x2 repetition of the input with each input zero on even rows painted 8, while preserving the observed dimensions through row/column doubling.

output.arguments:
{"hypotheses":[{"nl":"Double both dimensions; replicate each nonzero object in a 2x2 lattice, and fill the complementary even-row/even-column lattice with 8 only when a nonzero exists.","code":"def transform(grid):
 h=len(grid);w=len(grid[0]); has=any(v for row in grid for v in row); return [[(grid[r%h][c%w] if grid[r%h][c%w] else (8 if has and r%2==0 and c%2==0 else 0)) for c in range(2*w)] for r in range(2*h)]"},{"nl":"Double dimensions and copy every cell four times; additionally mark 8 at even/even output locations only if the input contains color 3.","code":"def transform(grid):
 h=len(grid);w=len(grid[0]); has=any(3 in row for row in grid); return [[grid[r%h][c%w] or (8 if has and r%2==0 and c%2==0 else 0) for c in range(2*w)] for r in range(2*h)]"},{"nl":"Scale by two in each axis, preserving zeros unless the input contains any nonzero, in which case zeros on output even/even sites become 8.","code":"def transform(grid):
 h=len(grid);w=len(grid[0]); has=any(any(row) for row in grid); return [[grid[r%h][c%w] or (8 if has and r%2==0 and c%2==0 else 0) for c in range(2*w)] for r in range(2*h)]"}]}
